snippet.title: Vampires: Bloodlord Rising | The official gamescom Trailer
snippet.description:
You are a vampire. Build a castle, manage your clan and expand your hold over Sangavia. Develop your character, experience a dramatic story in an open world and rule the land either alone or with your friends in co-op mode.

Prepare yourself for an unforgettable journey to Sangavia with the official trailer for gamescom 2025.

Wishlist now: https://bit.ly/WishlistVampires

About Toplitz Productions

Named after the mystic “Toplitz Lake” which is situated in a dense mountain forest high up in the Alps, Toplitz Productions was founded with the aim of developing and publishing computer and video games “with heart and soul”.
For more information, visit toplitz-productions.com.
